channel.title: The Seax: Essex news, sport and life
channel.description: The latest Essex news, sport and life, updated through the day.

image.title: The Seax: Essex news, sport and life

item.title: Southend United fight back to beat ten-man Aldershot Town 2-1 at Roots Hall
item.description: Second-half goals from Kyle McAdam and Tyreece Simpson kept Southend in the National League play-off places.

item.title: Isthmian North: Canvey Island hit five at Witham Town as Bowers & Pitsea win at Concord Rangers
item.description: It was a strong Saturday for Essex sides on the road, with Tilbury and Brightlingsea Regent also collecting away wins.

item.title: Chelmsford City knocked out of the FA Trophy on penalties at AFC Telford United
item.description: The Clarets were beaten 6-5 in a shootout in Shropshire despite two saves from goalkeeper Marriott.

item.title: Javelin great Fatima Whitbread made a Freewoman of Brentwood for her work with children in care
item.description: The former world champion, who grew up in children's homes, is the borough's newest honorary freewoman, just over a year after Thurrock gave her its own freedom.

item.title: Colchester United end 10-game winless run by beating Gillingham 2-0
item.description: Two goals inside nine second-half minutes at the JobServe Community Stadium lifted the mood in Colchester after weeks without a win.

item.title: Windmill Fields man banned for a year after cocaine drug-driving in Harlow
item.description: Christopher Boxall, 50, of Windmill Fields, Harlow, admitted drug-driving at Chelmsford Magistrates' Court.

item.title: Getting to an incident faster is no excuse, Essex chief warns after Braintree PC is sacked for speeding
item.description: The Braintree-based constable broke the limit 75 times in marked police cars over two months and used blue lights without being trained as a response driver.

item.title: Southend United hand former Tottenham academy defender Maxwell McKnight a one-year deal
item.description: The 22-year-old, who played for Brentford B last season, went straight into Kieron Dyer's starting line-up against Aldershot Town on Saturday 14 November.

item.title: Thameside Complex in Grays lit blue for Care Leavers Month
item.description: Thurrock Council is lighting the Thameside Complex blue through November 2026 and running go-karting, virtual reality and social events for young people leaving care.

item.title: Basildon Council offers tenants £1,500 and free removals to move to a smaller home
item.description: Basildon council tenants with spare bedrooms can claim a cash payment if they move to a smaller property, with the council covering removals, decorating and carpets.

item.title: Thurrock's minor injuries unit leaves Orsett for a bigger home at Thurrock Hospital
item.description: The Thurrock walk-in unit now has its own plaster room, a wound care room with a shower and X-ray next door, and is open 10am to 7.30pm every day.

item.title: Holders Billericay Town learn their path as Essex Senior Cup quarter-final draw is made
item.description: Witham Town could meet Colchester United, and Aveley host Hullbridge Sports, in the last eight of the BBC Essex Senior Cup.

item.title: Writtle pub's painters put their work on public show for the first time
item.description: Artists who have gathered at the Rose and Crown in Writtle, near Chelmsford, for more than two years are exhibiting paintings, cards and crafts.

item.title: Man arrested after threats at Maldon home where police were looking for missing man
item.description: A search for a missing man brought officers to a Maldon address, where they found someone else making threats.

item.title: Blood tests at St Margaret's Hospital in Epping switch to the new diagnostic centre on Monday
item.description: Patients having blood taken at St Margaret's Hospital, Epping, will be seen in the site's Community Diagnostic Centre instead of the main outpatients department.

item.title: NHS Essex puts £850,000 into braces to cut waits for young patients
item.description: Orthodontic practices across Essex will be paid to treat up to 500 extra children and young people.

item.title: RSPCA appeal after young cat dumped in box at Westcliff InPost parcel locker
item.description: A passer-by heard meowing from a box left at the InPost locker on Fairfax Drive in Westcliff-on-Sea and found a cat of about a year old inside.

item.title: Thurrock sites took in more scrapped-car waste than anywhere in England but Birmingham
item.description: Waste sites in Thurrock handle about seven in every ten tonnes of scrapped-vehicle waste recorded across Essex's districts.

item.title: Essex fixtures for Saturday 14 November: Colchester host Gillingham and Southend face Aldershot
item.description: Billericay Town and Waltham Abbey meet in an all-Essex FA Trophy tie, and there are two derbies in the Isthmian North.

item.title: Dispersal order covers central Southend into the evening as pier lights return and fireworks light the seafront
item.description: Essex Police cited intelligence about possible trouble between groups of young supporters of Southend United and Aldershot Town.

item.title: Community award winners to switch on Chelmsford's Christmas lights on Sunday
item.description: A packed afternoon of music, markets and fairground rides builds to the 5pm switch-on, with fireworks to finish.

item.title: Long-empty Shenfield shop on Hutton Road cleared to become a Londis
item.description: Brentwood Borough Council has licensed the empty unit at 144 Hutton Road, Shenfield, to sell alcohol from 8am to 11pm every day as a Londis convenience store.

item.title: Chelmsford Cathedral to remember Essex road victims at Sunday service after deaths rise to 58
item.description: The 2.30pm memorial service on 15 November, held with the Safer Essex Roads Partnership, opens the charity Brake's Road Safety Week.

item.title: Women of Grace UK, founded by Takeley campaigner Valerie Lolomari, wins King's Award for Voluntary Service
item.description: The survivor-led charity supports women and girls affected by female genital mutilation across Essex, Hertfordshire, Cambridgeshire and Enfield.

item.title: Inspector rejects five homes near Little Easton but orders Uttlesford to pay part of developer's costs
item.description: The Planning Inspectorate upheld Uttlesford District Council's refusal of homes on a field off Duck Street, while criticising its drainage objection.

item.title: Basildon man, 19, charged with GBH after man hurt in East Walk
item.description: Tyler Williamson, of Danbury Down, Basildon, is also charged with possessing a folding knife and has been remanded in custody.

item.title: Loughton dealer caught with loaded handgun jailed for 12 and a half years
item.description: Rocco Coakley and two younger men who called themselves the "original gangsters" have been jailed over a cocaine and ketamine operation run from Loughton.

item.title: ATM thief found hiding in Dagenham loft jailed after targeting cash machines in Essex and across Britain
item.description: Bogdan Gasparov, 40, was sentenced at Chelmsford Crown Court on 9 November to three years and six months after admitting theft from cash machines.

item.title: Thaxted's John Webb windmill named on Historic England's 2026 at-risk list
item.description: Thaxted Windmill in Uttlesford appears on Historic England's Heritage at Risk Register for 2026, the Dunmow Broadcast reports.

item.title: Essex Police concerned for missing Harlow man Jayden Baksh, 20
item.description: Officers want to find the Harlow man as quickly as possible and ask anyone who sees him to dial 999.

item.title: Maldon MP warns Hammonds Farm garden community could clog the A414 into town
item.description: Sir John Whittingdale has written to the planning inspector examining Chelmsford's Local Plan, saying the 3,000-home scheme would leave Maldon and Heybridge with worse congestion and few other routes.

item.title: Anglia Ruskin University seeks voluntary redundancies to cut staff bill by 10%
item.description: The university, which has campuses in Chelmsford plus Cambridge and Peterborough, spends about £150m a year on its workforce, the BBC reports.

item.title: Almost half of Stansted Airport passengers now arrive by train, bus or coach
item.description: More than 13.5 million people used public transport to reach London Stansted Airport over the past 12 months, the Bishop's Stortford Independent reports.

item.title: Inquest opens into death of Chelmsford boy, 2, who fell from Cyprus hotel window
item.description: Jaxon Foster died from multiple severe injuries on the first day of a family holiday in July, Essex Coroner's Court has heard.

item.title: Harlow man admits drug-driving on Southern Way and is given interim ban
item.description: Perry Brown, 38, of Long Banks, Harlow, pleaded guilty at Chelmsford Magistrates' Court to driving with cannabis in his blood above the legal limit.

item.title: Aveley cruise past Hutton 5-0 in the BBC Essex Senior Cup fourth round
item.description: Aveley's Isthmian Premier side were far too strong for their Essex Senior League hosts, with two substitutes scoring late on.

item.title: Thurrock pavement repairs finished in South Ockendon, Tilbury, Corringham and Grays
item.description: Thurrock Council's reactive highways team has resurfaced and rebuilt damaged footways on four streets, including Corran Way and Lodge Lane.

item.title: Tilbury shop that opens at 5am must keep its alcohol covered until 7am
item.description: Thurrock councillors have licensed LKR Express in Dock Road, Tilbury, to sell alcohol, with locked fridges and spirits kept behind the counter.

item.title: Rayleigh mother urges parents to learn the signs of type 1 diabetes after daughter's collapse
item.description: A Rayleigh woman whose 13-year-old was rushed to Southend Hospital with diabetic ketoacidosis has started a support group for families in the town.

item.title: Thurrock Council plans to save £995,000 as fewer families wait in emergency housing
item.description: Thurrock Council says the number of households it has placed in temporary accommodation is now falling by about 15 a month, after three years of steady rises.

item.title: Broomfield, Southend and Basildon hospital patients told to keep appointments as Microsoft email recovery continues
item.description: Microsoft says its email service is approaching normal levels after the global outage, but some messages are still arriving late.

item.title: Colchester's Christmas lights go on at 7.30pm on Saturday, with fireworks over Lion Walk
item.description: Colchester city centre hosts its free festive switch-on, with a choir, dancers and the Colchester Has Talent finalists on stage before Santa arrives.

item.title: St Osyth, Manningtree and Mistley get new conservation plans as Tendring cabinet signs them off
item.description: Three of Tendring's most historic places now have fresh rules guiding how their buildings, views and open spaces are looked after, with redrawn boundaries.

item.title: Almost 200 tonnes of glass collected from Tendring doorsteps in first month of new recycling rounds
item.description: Households across Tendring have taken to putting bottles and jars in their green boxes since the expanded Veolia service began.

item.title: Harlow man, 47, charged with two counts of harassment
item.description: Terrence Hill, of Little Brays, Harlow, is due back at Chelmsford Magistrates' Court on 3 December.

item.title: Basildon Council forms fly-tipping task force after clearing 1,696 dumps in six months
item.description: Hotspots across Basildon borough will be targeted first, with surveillance, intelligence gathering and faster clean-ups, Basildon Today reports.

item.title: Teenage girls' designs become Basildon's new Town Square seating and a five-way swing
item.description: Basildon town centre and Gloucester Park have new spaces shaped by local girls through the Make Space for Girls project.

item.title: Former PC who saw cyclist heading into traffic before fatal A130 crash would have been sacked, hearing rules
item.description: A misconduct hearing chaired by Essex Police Chief Constable Rachel Nolan found Nicholas Davies did not stop, turn round or report the rider he had seen in Chelmsford.

item.title: Dover man, 83, charged with indecent assault in Harlow dating back to 1974
item.description: An 83-year-old man from Dover in Kent will appear at Basildon Crown Court in December over an alleged offence in Harlow more than 50 years ago.

item.title: Essex football and cricket clubs to lead year-long push on men's mental health
item.description: Essex County Council is funding the Colchester United, Southend United and West Ham United community foundations, with cricket partners, to reach men through sport across the county.

item.title: Braintree Town beaten 2-0 at Salisbury despite facing ten men after half-time
item.description: The Braintree side had an extra man for the whole second half in Wiltshire but could not find a goal in the National League South.

item.title: Maldon council agrees to buy two plots at Langford to protect wildlife habitat from inappropriate use
item.description: Maldon District Council will try to buy two parcels of land at Langford, near Maldon, sold at auction in 2025, and can pay up to 10% above an independent valuation to secure the deal.

item.title: New rules for licensed pet and animal businesses across Basildon borough adopted until 2031
item.description: Basildon Council has formally adopted an Animal Activity Licensing Policy and Animal Charter for 2026 to 2031, replacing its old Animal Welfare Charter after a public consultation.

item.title: Air ambulance downwash seriously injured woman filming its take-off near Southend Airport, report finds
item.description: Accident investigators say the Essex & Herts Air Ambulance crew could not see the woman behind a hedge in Southend and flew on unaware she had been hurt.

item.title: Partially blind after eye cancer, Felix is now studying music at Colchester Institute
item.description: The teenage pianist told BBC News that music carried him through his illness.

item.title: Westcliff construction insurance specialist Blackhawk bought by Clear Group
item.description: Blackhawk Insurance Services in Westcliff-on-Sea, Southend, is now part of a Goldman Sachs-backed broking group, with the price kept private.

item.title: Witham man, 21, jailed for 12 months over drugs and phones package thrown into HMP Chelmsford
item.description: The Witham man admitted conspiring to get cannabis, tobacco and mobile phones over the wall of the Chelmsford prison, and was sentenced at Chelmsford Crown Court.

item.title: Police ask Harlow drivers to look out for missing William Knight and his white Seat Ateca
item.description: Essex Police are concerned for the 30-year-old and want anyone who sees him or the car to call 999.

item.title: Waltham Abbey man banned for a year after cannabis drug-driving in Epping
item.description: Stuart Thurgood, 44, of Homefield, Waltham Abbey, admitted driving a Nissan in Epping with cannabis in his blood above the legal limit.

item.title: Michael Rosen performs for more than 300 Harlow primary pupils at the Playhouse
item.description: Former children's laureate Michael Rosen brought his stories to schoolchildren in Harlow as part of Essex County Council's events for the National Year of Reading.
